## Problem

What problem would this feature solve? Describe the use case and why the current behavior is insufficient.

## Proposed shape

What would the API / behavior / configuration look like? Sketch the smallest viable surface.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you weigh, and why is the proposed shape preferable?

## ADR check

- [ ] I have read `docs/decisions.md`.
- [ ] This change would require a new ADR (architectural decision record).
